description: Consommation horaire définitive de gaz des distributions publiques à l'interface avec le réseau de transport de gaz is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données donne la consommation nationale brute de gaz des clients Distributions Publiques et ELD de NaTran et de Teréga. Les données sont agrégées de manière horaire et journalière et sont définitives. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consommation. Its keywords are LTECV. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
